tools.name: search_machines
tools.description: Find SlotMaps guides by slot machine name (e.g. 'buffalo', 'phoenix link', 'piggies'). Returns machine names and slugs.

tools.name: get_machine_overview
tools.description: How the advantage works on this machine: the free part of the SlotMaps guide. No exact thresholds.

tools.name: list_free_guides
tools.description: The five SlotMaps machine guides any agent can read in full for free, with photos.

tools.name: get_full_guide
tools.description: The complete SlotMaps guide: what to look for on the machine, the exact numbers to sit down at, risk and bankroll, plus the advantage-state photo when there is one. Free for 5 machines (list_free_guides); $1.99 per guide otherwise, paid through Stripe machine payments (MPP).

tools.name: read_machine_photo
tools.description: Send a photo of a slot machine on a casino floor (a public https image URL, or base64). SlotMaps identifies the machine, reads its visible state (meters, coins, pigs, counters) and says whether it's worth playing right now and why. $1.99 per photo, paid through Stripe machine payments.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_machine_photo · Public sink: read_machine_photo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_machine_photo · Public sink: read_machine_photo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
